README.md.role: Full package inventory, preservation list, and the exact go-live steps still needing Jesse's Cloudflare account

client/build.mjs.role: Plain Bun.build client bundle (bun-plugin-tailwind), outputs public/dashboard/

client/src/App.tsx.role: Moon + table UI, SDK-free copy (SafeAreaTopScrim replaced by env(safe-area-inset-top) spacer); behaviour and artwork unchanged

client/src/api.ts.role: Plain fetch client to ./api/* (no @hatch/space-sdk), ApiResponse helper type preserved

client/src/main.tsx.role: Plain QueryClient + createRoot(#root); no space SDK, no generated-space-root mount

client/src/types.ts.role: Zod response schemas copied verbatim from the server (dashboard payload v7, prices, pair series)

migrations/0001_snapshots.sql.role: D1 schema, identical to the Muse SQLite snapshots table: CREATE TABLE snapshots (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, fetched_at INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL). Worker prunes to newest 60 rows and ignores payloads with v != 7 on read.

public/dashboard/.role: Built client bundle: index.html + hashed JS/CSS + moon-surface webp

src/universe.ts.role: Token universe + 15 Nov 2026 research baseline (offline fallback), verbatim copy of server/src/universe.ts

src/worker.ts.role: Worker entrypoint + the four handlers (getDashboard {}, getPrices {}, getPairSeries {baseId, quoteId, days}, refreshDashboard {}) with identical request/response shapes and payload v7; D1 snapshot store; Cache API price cache (8s) and series cache (30 min) with per-isolate L1; scheduled() cron handler; /dashboard/api/* routing with ASSETS fallback; optional REFRESH_SECRET bearer on POST refresh

wrangler.toml.role: Worker config: name=investing-journal, main=src/worker.ts, route investing-journal.longfund.workers.dev/dashboard* (journal routes untouched), [assets] directory=./public binding=ASSETS, [[d1_databases]] binding=DB database_name=investing-journal-dashboard migrations_dir=migrations, [triggers] crons=["0 14 * * *"] (14:00 UTC = 06:00 America/Los_Angeles PST; 07:00 PDT — cron triggers are UTC-only, DST note in the file)
